params.body:
`composer audit` started failing on every pull request on 23 October. That day an advisory was published for `livewire/livewire` 4.3.0 up to 4.4.8: [GHSA-mhf7-xp6r-6qrc](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mhf7-xp6r-6qrc), medium, an authorization bypass in `#[Authorize]` through reordered parameter keys and `#[Json]` execution order. Naviskore was on 4.4.0.

**Exposure.** None found. The app uses neither `#[Authorize]` nor `#[Json]`. The bump is needed to keep the audit green, and to stay patched if either attribute is used later.

**Change.** `livewire/livewire` 4.4.0 → 4.4.8, nothing else in the lock file.

**One test changed.** In 4.4.8 the Livewire test harness lets `ModelNotFoundException`, `AuthorizationException` and HTTP exceptions become a response, the way a real request gets them, instead of throwing them into the test. `ACourseAndItsGoalsTest::a_goal_of_another_course_is_not_changed_through_this_one` caught the exception, so it failed although the guard still held. It now asserts a 404 and that `editing` stays null. When `Goals::edit` is changed to load any goal instead of one of the course's own, the test fails (200 instead of 404). No other test relies on the thrown exception.

**Tests.** Full suite on the workbench: 1366 passed, 21 failed. The 21 failures are the same as on `main` (Chrome, PDF and build-stamp tests that need the server). Pint passes.
params.title: Update Livewire to 4.4.8 for GHSA-mhf7-xp6r-6qrc
